Description: Operational health and verified source request metrics; deploy in the monitoring account after cross-account console sharing.

SourceAccountId.Description: Verified application account owning the native metrics.

SourceRegion.Description: Verified region of the application API and website metrics.

RestApiName.Description: Exact observed AWS/ApiGateway ApiName dimension; not the API ID.

RestApiStage.Description: Exact observed REST API Stage dimension.

ProbeFunctionName.Description: Physical Probe Lambda name from the monitoring stack.

NormalDeadLettersName.Description: Physical NormalDeadLetters queue name from the monitoring stack.

CriticalDeadLettersName.Description: Physical CriticalDeadLetters queue name from the monitoring stack.

EventDeadLettersName.Description: Physical EventDeadLetters queue name from the monitoring stack.

WebsiteLoadBalancer.Description: Verified full LoadBalancer dimension (app/name/id), never its ARN.

WebsiteTargetGroup.Description: Verified full TargetGroup dimension, never its ARN.
